messages:
Nadia Morales: Following up from the dry-run earlier — we have three blocker classes: permission errors fetching manifests, checksum mismatches on snapshots, and flaky post-restore smoke tests. I want owners and dates.

Jordan Patel: Thanks Nadia. Can you list the exact errors you saw?

Nadia Morales: Sure — manifest fetch fails with AccessDenied when running restore.sh as deployer-role. Then one snapshot had a checksum mismatch on file data.tar.lz4. Smoke test failures are mostly auth token issues.

Priya Singh: I'll take the manifest permission work (IAM role + policy audit). ETA 2026-03-31. I'll add a small verifier script to run before attempting restores.

Samir Khan: I can debug the checksum mismatch — likely an upload verification gap in our backup job. I'll compare local digest vs S3 ETag and add a tidy script. ETA 2026-04-02.

Ashley Chen: I'll own smoke test flakiness and mapping which tests are brittle vs real failures. Plan: hard-fail only critical user flows. ETA 2026-03-30.

incident-bot: Postmortem DR-2026-03-22 updated: follow-ups required. Use /checklists/dr-dryrun to track tasks.

Nadia Morales: Short-term checklist (this week):
- Priya Singh 1 verify IAM for deployer-role to read bucket manifests; add explicit sts:AssumeRole and s3:GetObject tests. ETA: 2026-03-31
- Samir Khan 1 run checksum sweep across last 7 snapshots and list any diffs; add checksum regression alert. ETA: 2026-04-02
- Ashley Chen 1 prune flaky smoke tests and pin baseline responses for login + key api route. ETA: 2026-03-30
- Jordan Patel 1 file runbook PR with a preflight verification step and a required checkbox for KV priming. ETA: 2026-03-29

Priya Singh: Preflight script I'll add (example):
```
# manifest access check
aws sts get-caller-identity
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-backups/region-eu/latest/manifest.json /tmp/manifest.json
jq .checksum /tmp/manifest.json
```
Will include exact policy snippet in PR.

Samir Khan: For checksum comparison I'll add this helper: 
```
# compute sha256
sha256sum data.tar.lz4 | awk '{print $1}'
aws s3api head-object --bucket redwood-backups --key region-eu/2026-03-22/data.tar.lz4 --query ETag
```
Note: ETag may not be sha256 for multipart uploads; I'll normalise in the backup job.

Jordan Patel: Medium-term (30 days):
- ops-runbooks 1 implement automated canary restore CI job that runs weekly and reports diffs 1 ops-runbooks 1 2026-04-25
- Backup pipeline hardening: resume-after-failure logic, multipart checksum normalisation 1 Samir Khan 1 2026-04-18
- Runbook restructure: separate preflight / restore / post-verify sections; add run-to-region routing play for rollback. 1 Jordan Patel 1 2026-04-10

ops-runbooks: We'll scaffold the canary job once you provide the preflight & verify commands. Prefer a small container that runs those scripts and emits pass/fail metrics.

Ashley Chen: Communication and ops play: during a real failover we should thread updates to #incidents and also call out the Active DR lead in the first message. I'll add an Ops role assignment table to the runbook.

Nadia Morales: Also found this odd behavior: when we restored staging, background job consumer lag spiked and rerouted messages to the wrong queue. Include explicit quiesce + resume steps in runbook.

Priya Singh: Noted. I'll add SQS/quorum checks before cutover and a sample command to requeue with dedupe keys.

Samir Khan: One more: backup retention policy had a mismatch: the EU bucket lifecycle showed 90d while our SLA says 365d. I'll file a ticket to reconcile lifecycle rules and ensure manifests include retention metadata. Owner: Samir. ETA: 2026-04-05.

Jordan Patel: Good catch. Make that a medium-term policy task and mark it as high priority.

incident-bot: New checklist created: /checklists/dr-dryrun-manifest-and-restore (assigned: Priya Singh)

Ashley Chen: Meeting: let's do a 20-min sync tomorrow 11:00am PT to review PRs and blockers. If anyone can't make it, post updates here.

Priya Singh: I'll post the IAM policy diff in DR-2026-03-22 by EOD today.

Samir Khan: I'll publish a backup job log extract showing failed upload attempts and the suspected boundary for multipart issues.

Nadia Morales: Final ask: when you open PRs, please include a one-line "how to validate" so ops-runbooks can wire the automation easily.

Jordan Patel: Agreed. Also let's adopt a no-silent-fail rule: any preflight failing must block an automated restore. We'll enforce in CI.

Ashley Chen: +1 to blocking preflight. I'll update the smoke test YAML with the failing thresholds.

Samir Khan: I'll follow up with a short note on multipart checksum strategy and a small library we can reuse.

Priya Singh: Adding iam and s3 test steps to the runbook PR now.

Nadia Morales: Thanks all — keep updates inline on this thread and link PRs to DR-2026-03-22. Closing until tomorrow's sync. :white_check_mark:
